captureBlocker: NO_ROUTE: sim.sh --arg now passes -scenario (orchestration, 2026-11-27), but sim.sh captures only the screen shown after launch, and this screen needs a tab change (Plano) or a push (Treino). Blocked until the app has a Debug launch argument that opens a tab or a session (routed by the orchestrator). No XCUITest or hand-made screenshot substitutes for a sim.sh run.
